description: This is a PHP class file defining the Opencart admin controller for sale voucher management. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, and deleting vouchers, and manages various aspects of voucher data such as sender/recipient info, amount, status, and associated themes.

classes.name: Voucher
classes.description: Controller class for managing sale vouchers in the OpenCart admin panel. Handles listing, form display, and processing actions for vouchers.
